lines.zh: 我的六条腿都埋在沙里。
lines.en: All six of my legs are buried in sand.
Something sweet in the sand — honey.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，只露出上颚。
lines.en: Buried in sand, only my mandibles show.
A cactus ahead. No way around it.
I creep along the old sand trail.
I sweep the grains aside with my mandibles.
Today's path is hotter than yesterday's.
Beneath the sand, I inch along.
The wind has erased the road.

lines.zh: 我只露出一对颚，沙就够我藏。
lines.en: Only my mandibles show; the sand hides the rest.

lines.zh: 这条路没有尽头，只有沙。
lines.en: This road has no end, only sand.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，一步都不动。
lines.en: Buried in sand, I don't move a step.

lines.zh: 我走了三步，其实是沙塌。
lines.en: I take three steps; really, the sand gives way.

lines.zh: 毒针从沙里出来，先说好。
lines.en: The poisoned dart comes out of the sand — fair warning.
The sand deepens to my chest.

lines.zh: 我的腿埋在沙里，动不了。
lines.en: My legs are buried. I can't move.
I wait for night, when it's cooler.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只用毒刺招呼。
lines.en: I never move; I greet with venom.

lines.zh: 我数着沙粒滚落的声音。
lines.en: I count the sound of falling grains.

lines.zh: 有几只眼睛，就有几份困。
lines.en: Each eye carries its own weariness.
My stinger rests beneath my jaws.
The sun makes my shell shine.
The dune's shadow shifts half an inch.
The wind fills in my burrow mouth.
It's stuffy below, but no one comes for me.
I listen to insects crawling in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的东西，我来捡。
lines.en: I gather what the sand buries.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫从我头上走过。
lines.en: A beetle walks over my head.
I'm hidden in the sand. You can't see me.

lines.zh: 我在沙里一动不动，等你走近。
lines.en: I lie motionless in the sand, waiting for you to come near.
I know the iron hanging at your waist.
Your steps make the sand jump.

lines.zh: 你的脚挡住了我的阳光。
lines.en: Your feet block my sunlight.

lines.zh: 我一步也挪不动，只会投。
lines.en: I can't move a step; I only hurl.
One more step and you'll crush me.

lines.zh: 沙里八只眼睛都看见你了。
lines.en: Eight eyes in the sand all see you.

lines.zh: 埋在沙里，连腿都动不了。
lines.en: Buried in sand, I cannot move a leg.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，只露出口器。
lines.en: Buried in the sand, only my mouthparts show.
Sand pours into my wound.
My venom sac is intact. I can still fire.
That blow missed anything vital.
The sand will cover this wound.
A chunk of my sandy shell is knocked away.
Don't trample me. I'm buried below.
My antennae flatten back against the sand.
Come near and I vanish.
Who struck from under the sand?

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，动不了，只能射。
lines.en: I'm buried in sand — I can't move, only shoot.
Rust smells better than meat.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，只伸出一对颚。
lines.en: Buried in sand, I show only my mandibles.

lines.zh: 那块肉离我的颚太远了。
lines.en: That meat is too far from my jaws.
I open my jaws and get only sand.
Give me half and I will not shoot.

lines.zh: 再凑近些，我的颚够得到。
lines.en: Closer, and my mandibles can reach.
Buried in sand, I can't move.
Wave it and my head follows.
The scent in the sand is poison.
Something sweet has seeped into the sand.
I wobble, and the sand collapses.
Your boot sole pins my mandibles.
That stomp rattles my shell.
Stop stomping on my head.
The sand you kick buries me.
I'm buried here, and you stepped on me.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，一根指头都动不了。
lines.en: Buried in sand, I cannot move a finger.
I can't get up. I can only take it.

lines.zh: 我连一步都挪不了，还踩。
lines.en: I cannot take a step, and you still tread on me.
Let us both step back, yes?

lines.zh: 跳个舞？我在沙里转不了圈。
lines.en: Dance? I cannot spin inside sand.

lines.zh: 我这辈子都不会挪地方了。
lines.en: I will never move from this spot.
I tap the burrow wall with my antennae.
Buried in sand, I do not move.
She's buried in another patch of sand.
Stuck in sand, and you walk too fast.
My wings quiver softly in the sand.
When the rains come, we'll move.
I give up half the burrow mouth.
The nest below is room enough for us.
The edge of an enchanted page shows above the sand.
This enchanted book is my salvage.
I drag it in with my mandibles.
Buried in sand, I cannot move.
Too small to matter. I tuck it between my plates.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，只能够到这些。
lines.en: Buried as I am, this much is all I can reach.
Someone dropped meat. It's mine.
A nugget of iron turns up in the sand.
It's blocking my burrow entrance.
Arrows fire out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我抛东西，从沙里抛出来。
lines.en: I throw from inside the sand.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里，你跑不远的。
lines.en: I am buried in sand, you will not get far.
I've aimed this one for a long time.
The one showing above the sand — you.
Each of my eight eyes holds a different angle.
I'm buried in sand, and I fire the moment you move.

lines.zh: 我的尾针转过去对准你。
lines.en: My stinger turns to aim at you.
I've been hungry for more than a season.
A shift in the sand tells me where you are.
My jaws tighten beneath the sand.
You've stepped into my range.
Your scent has soaked into the sand.
Come close, and I vanish.
Hiding behind that rock won't help.
Eight eyes, one target.
Your panting gave you away.

lines.zh: 我动不了，可我的毒能到。
lines.en: I cannot move, but my venom reaches.
I aim at your shadow.
The more you run, the less dust hides you.
I don't take a step; my arrows do.
I needn't chase you. My stinger will.
You've kicked away the sand at my burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 沙丘挡不住飞出去的东西。
lines.en: A dune won't stop what flies.
My venom waits for you in the sand.
Nice dodge — and the next bolt?

lines.zh: 我隐起身，你就找不到目标。
lines.en: I vanish and you lose your target.
Venom runs down the barb and in.
You clutch your leg. Good.
The barb points at your calf.

lines.zh: 沙里射出的毒针，你别急着拔。
lines.en: Don't be quick to pull the poisoned spike.
The sand flies, and the barb arrives.
Another one is coming. Don't rush.
This stinger flies out of the sand.
Bit you, and the venom went in.
My venom sting rises out of the sand.
There's no path over these dunes.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是沙丘。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a dune.
I'm buried in the sand, crouched and ready.
Only wind and sand around me.
The sun bakes the sand hot.
I've waited under the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙里一睁眼就开弓。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the sand and draw.
My antennae touch the sand first.

lines.zh: 沙粒从我的甲缝里滑落。
lines.en: Sand slides out from between my plates.
Flames lick my shell, and nothing happens.
I fall, and the sand falls with me.
Water floods my mouthparts.
The sand is blown skyward.
Someone else shoots from hiding too.

lines.zh: 法术打中腿，我挪不动了。
lines.en: Magic hit my legs; I can't move.
Buried in sand, I can't move.
Lightning strikes the dune top.
The void has not even sand.
